Log Retention Days
fields.description: Sync Logs older than this many days are deleted daily. 0 keeps every log.

fields.label: Per-Run: Send On
fields.description: Only applies in 'Per Run' mode: whether each run alerts on Failures, All, or Never.

fields.label: Telegram Bot Token
fields.description: Optional. If blank, falls back to Zoom Telegram Settings (if the zoom_meeting app is installed).

fields.label: Telegram Chat ID
fields.description: Chat or group id that receives sync alerts.

fields.label: Alert Email Recipients
fields.description: Email addresses for sync alerts, separated by commas or new lines. Uses the site's outgoing email account. Leave empty to send alerts only to Telegram.

fields.label: Include Error Details in Alerts
fields.description: Off (recommended): alerts say which DocType failed and which Sync Log to open, without the error text. Error messages can quote record names or field values, and Telegram and email are outside this site.

fields.label: Alert Mode
fields.description: Consolidated (recommended): one digest per sync batch, sent only when something failed, plus a daily summary. Per Run: a message after every run. Never: no alerts.
